newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telepizza shares rationed out amid hefty demand.
newsitem.headline: Telepizza shares rationed out amid hefty demand.

text.p: Demand for Telepizza has prompted a strict apportionment of shares, leaving each retail investor with seven shares plus 2.3 percent of the amount each requested, according to sources at BBV Interactivos, which is coordinating the initial public offering.
The overall value of the flotation rose thanks to a reserve of shares set aside in case of heavy demand under an over-allotment, or "green shoe" clause, bourse watchdog CNMV said.
Both Transeuropean Research Traders SA and Grelar Galicia SA exercised options under this clause which adds, respectively, 193,408 and 128,580 shares to the overall offer, the CNMV said.
The total volume of shares allotted was 2,173,418 for retail investors, 767,950 shares for the Spanish institutional tranche, and 1,888,448 for foreign investors, bourse watchdog CNMV said.
